title: Beyond rate limits: scaling access to Codex and Sora
summary: How OpenAI built a real-time access system combining rate limits, usage tracking, and credits to power continuous access to Sora and Codex.
body: How OpenAI built a real-time access system combining rate limits, usage tracking, and credits to power continuous access to Sora and Codex.
summaryZh: OpenAI介绍了其为Codex和Sora构建的实时访问系统。该系统通过整合速率限制、使用情况追踪及信用额度管理，旨在为用户提供更稳定、持续的API访问体验，解决了大规模模型部署中的资源调度问题。原始信息显示：How OpenAI built a real-time access system combining rate limits, usage tracking, and credits to power continuous access to Sora and Codex.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Beyond rate limits: scaling access to Codex and Sora”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI优化了Codex和Sora的访问系统，通过精细化的速率限制和信用管理保障持续访问。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
